description: Defines the Drupal taxonomy vocabulary entity class, including its properties, methods, and configuration annotations.

classes.name: Vocabulary
classes.description: Represents a taxonomy vocabulary entity in Drupal, with properties for ID, name, description, weight, and revision settings, and methods for lifecycle management and property access.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the vocabulary.

methods.name: preDelete
methods.description: Performs actions before deleting vocabulary entities, such as deleting associated terms.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Performs cleanup after vocabulary entities are deleted, including cache reset and field storage cleanup.

methods.name: setNewRevision
methods.description: Sets whether the vocabulary should create a new revision.

methods.name: shouldCreateNewRevision
methods.description: Checks if a new revision should be created for the vocabulary.
